manifest.description: Finite five-seed study of real EMBED update feedback, bounded history readouts, and MDMT information value.
manifest.plan_commit_resolution: Record the actual commit containing this directory at prepare; main_read_base is not the new plan commit.

source_protocol.loss: mean source BCE over natural rows and two tasks; preserve source masks and denominator

gaussian_d0.loss: source Gaussian replacement with original batch denominator

gaussian_d0_parent__clean_student.student_loss: same Clean hard/soft BCE as Clean KD

source_protocol.new_streams: separate named deterministic streams; never advance source training RNG
source_protocol.group_G: shared EMBED coordinates only; excludes domain embedding
source_protocol.group_N: complement of actual shared group S

environment.input_policy: Paths may be adapted; source data/split/feature/domain/task/panel hashes must match. No new Test load before global freeze.

evaluation.checkpoint_rule: earliest strict maximum; update only if score > best
evaluation.A_selection_prefix: same parent E1-E20 curves and immutable prefix-best packets included
evaluation.U_definition: mean over five seeds of each candidate own-selected full-Validation six-cell Macro AUC
evaluation.score_dtype: source float32 probability; raw logit combinations then float32 sigmoid
evaluation.auc_aggregation: full population, never mean batch AUC
evaluation.logloss_rule: Same AUC-selected object; independently report delta LL < 0 as improvement, otherwise cost/no improvement; never veto AUC qualification.
evaluation.test_policy: One global freeze after all triggered tasks and controls complete; evaluate frozen endpoints only; never add HPO from Test.

published_baselines.comparison_policy: Pair same dataset and seed; retain fixed primary published model per dataset, no per-seed model oracle.

route_A.native_control: same-seed parent O/F at same epoch, full native Adam state
route_A.numerator: q = observed current gradient + coupled WD * pre-step theta on present-gradient G coordinates
route_A.magnitude: r = L2 norm of actual native G displacement a, computed FP64
route_A.patch: b=r*c/||c||; w=(1-direction_alpha)*a+direction_alpha*b; d=r*w/||w||; G <- pre-step G + d
route_A.degenerate_policy: Finite zero norm or near-cancellation: exact fallbacks and counters in 12; NaN/Inf: BLOCKED_ENGINEERING, never silently native-fallback.
route_A.moment_policy: Native m/v and per-tensor step continue updating; do not freeze unused m or reset v; subsequent gradients use patched parameters.

simple_alternative.gate: G_A before starting RAW; then G_A_RAW

split.state_dtype: source F float32; construct difference/division FP64 then cast float32

route_B.cross_family_tie_preference: B_SHARED_ONLY when both pass and U difference <= 1e-4
route_B.history_storage: Only required sparse F references and selected immutable packets in RAM; no all-step model storage
route_B.KD_initialization_requirement: Pin actual FP32 parent F at every teacher-candidate selected epoch; not reconstructed from rounded barycenters.
forbidden_expansion: rerun full-step q to reconfirm old result

route_C.risk: mean FP64 softplus(-positive_negative_logit_margin) over fixed PA rank pairs per cell
route_C.pair_policy: unique deterministic bounded hash sampling once per seed/panel/cell; see 14 exact contract
route_C.global_risk: equal mean of six cell risks
route_C.fit: alpha_G argmin global risk; alpha_hat_c argmin cell risk; alpha_c=(1-s)*alpha_G+s*alpha_hat_c; no projection after shrinkage
risk_tie_order: closest to current old mass a
route_C.timing: fit using PA at end of e; apply absolute alpha to current states at e+1; do not remap by warm-up mass
route_C.PARAM_rule: Actual forward of theta_S=(1-alpha)*mu_R+alpha*mu_O, N=F_N; evaluate actual logits, never substitute PRED mixture margins.
route_C.selection: shared shrinkage per dataset from five-seed U; prefer s=.5 within HPO tie
route_C.simple_strategy_policy: Retain GLOBAL_PRED or GLOBAL_PARAM if G_C_GLOBAL even when CELL has no incremental information.

distillation.teacher_choice: highest five-seed U; within 1e-6 prefer B_SPLIT then C_GLOBAL_PRED then C_CELL_PRED
distillation.teacher_scope: same-seed frozen own-selected parent predictor, train soft targets only; no Test/Validation targets
distillation.student_initialization: actual parent F at the teacher selected epoch, not parent F own-selected epoch
distillation.objective: (1-distill_weight)*source_BCE(y) + distill_weight*source_BCE(stopgrad(teacher_probability)); same natural masks and mean denominator
distillation.student_F_initialization: same as student theta at e0
distillation.online_readout: record independently, not an extra search dimension

controls.KD_LABEL: both LR values, weight0, same initialization/5 epochs/fresh optimizer
controls.KD_FTEACHER: F at same teacher epoch supplies train probabilities; winning KD lambda/LR, same initialization/5 epochs

gaussian_transfer.teacher_config: inherit Clean frozen teacher family/H/scope/mode/shrinkage; Gaussian own-selected epoch
gaussian_transfer.student_initialization: actual Gaussian parent F at that teacher epoch

AB.B_config_freeze: after all five Clean parents complete, before A short forks
AB.extra_A_readouts: one frozen B config only, two forwards per epoch
AB.full_curve: parent E1-E20; actual A E21-E26; continuation E27-E50
AB.prefix_packet: At E20 pin all 12 B prefix-best predictors plus O/F; after five-seed B selection trim to the one frozen B configuration

G_A.statistic: mean over seeds of equal mean of E25/E26 delta_F and E40/E41 delta_F
G_A.next: one passing MATCH full continuation; run RAW shorts

G_B.comparison: best B_SPLIT own-selected U minus parent F U

G_C_GLOBAL.comparison: each GLOBAL mode U minus F U

G_KD_ENTER.comparison: teacher U minus best one-forward unified alternative U

G_KD_HISTORY.also_report: student minus better of both LABEL LRs

G_SIMPLE_KD.attribution: do not attribute to historical teacher information

FORMAL_AUC.population: independent own-selected Test after global freeze
FORMAL_AUC.comparison: predeclared published model, primary fixed strongest model per dataset

job_templates.requires: current dataset five P.C COMPLETE and parent B frozen
G_B for collection and respective A short gate for full curve

worker_hours_estimate.status: historical order-of-magnitude; recalibrate with new smoke, not a wall-clock stop

budgets.parameter_storage: RAM only; no model/optimizer/checkpoint files, mmap or tmpfs
forecast_includes: immutable E20 B and O/F prefix-best
budgets.parameter_unit_estimate_warning: 65P/seed is not an upper bound; adding B/O/F prefix packets yields 91P before sparse histories, transient copies and other states. Use exact scope-aware reference graph, not a hard-coded multiple.
budgets.deadlock_rule: prepare must forecast completion of whole five-seed block under budgets before training; do not stall at an impossible barrier.
budgets.scheduler: independent per-GPU admission, resource reservations, one owner, at most one prefetched future dataset block

recovery.epoch_commit: RAM commit then atomic observation files then COMMITTED receipt
recovery.lost_guardian: deterministic parent-prefix and branch replay with original identity; never reconstruct parameters from scalar files
recovery.OOM: lower concurrency or eval microbatch; keep training batch/seed/epochs

mandatory_comparisons: complete method vs each published model
complete method vs matched ordinary online O
manifest.implementation_readiness: Design reviewed. Separate future coder/reviewer, contract-specific tests and two dataset engineering smoke receipts are required before execute. No performance pruning from smoke.

original: closest to current old mass a
resolved: closest to current old mass a
